title: A Python rule that relay's agents see in every session
what: A relay rule rules/python.md, loaded only by relay for now: standard library at run time, gate tools pinned and installed by the install script; types on every new or changed function, one typed record and one parser per record that several programs read, and one checking parser at the boundary for data relay does not control (Claude Code transcripts, hook input); formatter and auto-fix run before every commit, the linter reports bugs; subprocess with list arguments, no shell=True, time limits through Python; tests use temporary folders, never live .relay/queue, .relay/checks or docs/handover.md; anything beyond a thin wrapper is Python, bash is on its way out.
why: Owner, verbatim: "1. a" (a rule loaded only by relay, over a doc nobody is told to read), after answering the six points ("1. Согласен ... 3. ... автоматического форматирования ... 4. Согласен 5. Проблема наблюдается 6. Думаю в будущем мы полностью перейдём на python").
